sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Hides ads in the library, story pages, reader and comments. Rewarded videos for coins still play.
Unlocks Premium+ with unlimited offline stories, reading themes and no interstitials in the reader. Paid stories still cost coins.
